text:
Ella: quick sync — trying to settle tradeoffs between row compactness in the compare table and visibility of variant metrics (latency, p99, cost). Sales says customers miss the metrics until they open the side panel. do we surface everything inline or keep a lean primary row?

Sam (Design): leaning toward a 2-tier density. show the 2 most critical metrics inline (latency, p99) and a subtle chevron that expands a short metrics strip. keeps scannability + discoverability. :thinking_face:

Jay (Frontend): agreed on the 2-tier idea. technically we can lazy-render the expanded metrics to avoid perf hit. also we can animate height with reduced-motion prefs. snippet for the expanded strip: 
```css
.compare-row .metrics-strip { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.metrics-item { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
```

Marta (A11y): ok but a11y nits: the chevron needs an accessible label (eg "Show variant metrics"), and expanded content must be keyboard focusable and announced by a live region or aria-expanded on the control. contrast on the inline metric values is borderline on 2 of the theme colors. we should bump to 4.5:1.

Ella: good call on labels. Sam—can microcopy be something like "show metrics" -> but shorter? sales asked for more context: e.g., show delta vs baseline inline for p99 if available. would that be too noisy?

Sam (Design): maybe show delta as a tiny colored delta chip next to p99 (green for better, red for worse). keep it micro: single character +/- and % on hover. example: `+3%` with tooltip "vs baseline". :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Jay (Frontend): delta chip sounds fine. implement as an inline <abbr> or aria-describedby tooltip for screen readers. performance badges (we currently show a flame icon) — should they live next to model name or tucked into metrics area? placement affects scanning.

Marta (A11y): if the badge conveys status, it must have an accessible name and color shouldn't be the only signal. add a short text alternative (eg "fast") visible to screen readers.

Ella: proposal: model row left: name + small perf badge (icon with sr-only label). middle: 2 inline metrics (latency, p99 + delta chip). right: actions + chevron to expand full metrics. open to swapping badge to metrics area if scanning tests show better recognition.

Sam (Design): mock incoming later today — i'll include two density options (compact vs comfortable) and copy for the badge tooltip. also will test keyboard-only flow.

Jay (Frontend): i'll prototype the lazy-render + CSS and wire up focus management. FYI deploy-bot: will open a PR once design-approved.

deploy-bot: PR #4321 opened by jay for compare table metrics strip prototype — link: https://git.internal/r/4321 :white_check_mark:

Marta (A11y): small checklist before merge: aria-expanded on chevron, aria-controls to point to expanded region, focus trap not needed but focus must go into the expanded content when opened via keyboard, color contrast >= 4.5, delta chip has text alternative. i'll review once PR is up. :mag:

Ella: perfect — thanks everyone. if the prototype looks good we'll run a short usability test with two power-user sales reps and one voiceover test. aim to ship to dev environment next sprint. :rocket:
